name: MSE 3055
title: Materials Processing and Microstructures Laboratory
description: Second semester of a 3-semester MSE laboratory sequence. Application of advanced characterization techniques, including x-ray diffraction, electron microscopy, differential scanning calorimetry, thermogravimetric analysis and Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy, to all major classes of materials. Analysis of complex data sets. Culminates in a junior design project.
